name: Suzhou Gyz Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou Gyz Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of precision electronic components in China and internationally. The company also provides insert molding and other products; high-precision injection molded parts comprising mobile camera, VCM motor, connector, transmission, car camera, and air conditioning parts; winding, LDS, automation, and ultra precision machining products; and manufacturing equipment. In addition, it engages in mold processing; metal stamping parts processing; and plating activities. The company exports its products.
